subtitle: Lesson 36 · A concept T-SQL doesn't have

caption: Callers see only what's listed here — the contract, not the implementation.

eyebrow: The body: implementation, plus private helpers
code:
CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE BODY order_pkg AS
  FUNCTION compute_tax (p_subtotal NUMBER) RETURN NUMBER
  IS BEGIN RETURN p_subtotal * 0.08; END;
  -- compute_tax is PRIVATE: not in the spec,
  -- so nothing outside the package can call it
END order_pkg;
/
caption: The body can change freely; callers and the spec stay untouched.

eyebrow: Package variables persist for the whole session
caption: A genuinely unique Oracle capability: session-persistent, package-level state.

code:
-- Closest T-SQL gets: same-schema procs
dbo.GetOrderTotal
dbo.ApplyDiscount
-- No spec/body split, no private package state,
-- no package-level session-persistent variable
caption: An organizational convention, not a language feature.
